recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key portrait of a young man in a light grey sweatshirt, holding an anatomical heart in his hand. A large black ink splatter appears over his chest, suggesting a void. The background is dark and textured with white scratches and dust, featuring large, stylized gothic-inspired red typography in the upper right and clean sans-serif text at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The red anatomical heart held in the hand mirrors the red color of the primary display text.
The black ink splatter on the chest creates a visual void that contrasts with the light sweatshirt.
The diagonal white scratches in the background lead the eye from the subject toward the typography.
coreInvariants: Low-key, high-contrast lighting on the subject's face.
Desaturated color palette with deep red as the only vibrant accent.
Distressed, grimy texture overlays across the entire composition.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of the subject centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The anatomical heart held in the hand, emphasized by its bright red color against the dark background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down to the ink splatter, follows the arm up to the heart, and finishes at the large red title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark negative space in the upper left and right corners to allow for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black providing a somber, moody background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light grey of the sweatshirt to make the subject pop from the shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blood red used for the heart and the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the sweatshirt and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses elongated ascenders and descenders with sharp, thorn-like serifs.
Secondary text uses wide tracking and thin, uniform stroke weights.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The initial letter of the title features an oversized, sweeping flourish that wraps around the following characters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between ornate, emotional Gothic type and cold, clinical Sans-Serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sharp, gothic aesthetic of the primary title.
Provides the clean, wide-tracked geometric look for the metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody portrait of a young man in a grey sweatshirt against a dark, textured background with white scratches. He is holding a realistic red anatomical heart. A large black ink splatter is centered on his chest.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large red Gothic-style title in the upper right and a thin, wide-tracked white sans-serif name at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the ink splatter centered on the chest?
Is the heart the primary red focal point?
Is the background sufficiently dark and distressed?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact shape of the ink splatter
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the dark background.
Check that the heart looks anatomical rather than a symbol.
Verify the scratch texture doesn't obscure the subject's face.
Confirm the wide tracking on the bottom text is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a desaturated portrait with a symbolic object (heart), a destructive graphic element (splatter), and a high-contrast typographic pairing (Gothic + Sans-Serif) under a heavy grunge texture.
